tier_reason: Gist author's own run on an i5-8250U via skeeto/prng64-shootout: xoshiro8x256pp 4922.28 MB/s vs xoshiro256pp 2619.20 and pcg64 1576.86 MB/s. Harness is public and its Makefile defaults to cc -std=c99 -O3 -march=native, but the gist does not state the compiler or the flags it used, so this is not A.

corrections.compiler_and_flags: not stated in gist; prng64-shootout Makefile default is cc -std=c99 -O3 -g3 -march=native (unconfirmed for this run)
corrections.caveats: No license stated; compiler/flags not stated in gist (shootout Makefile default -O3 -march=native); single laptop CPU; requires adding the generator to skeeto/prng64-shootout to reproduce. Same page lists the shootout's baseline_simd at 12078 MB/s (an upper-bound reference, not a PRNG). Gist, not a repo.

notes: Numbers match the page exactly; the author says "~3x faster than PCG64". The vectorized design follows Vigna's xoshiro256++-vect-speed.c. No license, so it stays reference.
